news.title: China Deploys 5G Across Manufacturing Base as 6G Testing Advances, CCTV Reports
news.dek: China is expanding the use of 5G across its manufacturing sector, with more than 26,000 private industrial 5G networks built nationwide, China Central Television said on Saturday.
news.aiSummary: China has constructed over 26,000 private industrial 5G networks across its manufacturing sector. This expansion is occurring simultaneously with the advancement of 6G testing, as reported by China Central Television.

news.title: Anthropic Researcher Claims to Solve Riemann Problem With Claude
news.dek: On the heels of Anthropic PBC’s record-breaking initial public offering, a researcher at the company said he believes he used its artificial intelligence software to solve a famous number theory problem that has plagued mathematicians for more than 150 years.
news.aiSummary: Following Anthropic's initial public offering, a company researcher stated that he used the firm's AI software, Claude, to solve the Riemann Hypothesis. This number theory problem has remained unsolved by mathematicians for over 150 years.

news.title: Cut self-hosted LLM cost and latency with the distributed KV caching agent skill
news.dek: Self-hosting LLMs on GPUs means paying to recompute the same context on every turn. Distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache can cut inference cost by up to 40% and time to first token by up to 80%. This post walks through the distributed KV caching skill in the Agent Toolk
news.aiSummary: Self-hosting large language models on GPUs often incurs high costs and latency due to the repeated recomputation of context. By implementing distributed KV caching with Amazon ElastiCache, organizations can reduce inference costs by up to 40% and decrease time to first token by up to 80%. The article details how to utilize the distributed KV caching skill within the Agent Toolkit to achieve these performance improvements.

news.aiSummary: Former New York Fed President Bill Dudley and Columbia Law School's Kathryn Judge analyze potential actions by the Treasury and Federal Reserve to address the national debt crisis. The discussion also covers the implications of Grand Theft Auto 6's release for a video game industry characterized by frequent layoffs and delays.

news.title: US tech stocks plunge into bear market in worst week since Covid-19 crisis
news.dek: Shares in Anthropic and Nvidia tumble as fears over the AI spending boom grip Wall Street
news.aiSummary: US tech stocks have entered a bear market, marking their worst weekly performance since the start of the Covid-19 crisis.
